content: Execute cargo build, fix any compilation errors to ensure build passes without errors
Audit all production Rust source files to remove unwrap() calls, replacing with ? or explicit error handling (exclude test and benchmark files)
Run cargo clippy -- -D warnings, fix all reported warnings to ensure no warnings are emitted
Run cargo test --all-features, fix any test failures to ensure all tests pass including integration tests and crash recovery tests (WAL truncation, SSTable corruption)
Run cargo audit, update dependencies or mitigate any critical or high unrecognized vulnerabilities
Execute scripts/workflow-agent.ts to validate all ci.yml jobs that do not require external secrets, fix any job failures
